search_aliases: Walkway between Mission Bay Blocks 9 and 9A
summary: Walkway on its own Assessor lot (8719004, 406 China Basin St) between Mission Bay South Block 9 (HomeRise, 410 China Basin St) and Block 9A (400 China Basin St). The OCII Commission's Resolution No. 08-2024, adopted April 16, 2024, approved the design of Lot B of Bridgeview Way, 'a private mid-block Vara corridor, between Blocks 9 and 9A': a more pedestrian-oriented corridor, with local vehicular access removed and removable bollards for emergency vehicle access. The resolution says FOCIL is obliged to construct Bridgeview Way and that on completion ownership and maintenance pass to the Mission Bay homeowner's association. On October 27, 2026 Pier & Point's founder photographed the lot fenced, with a mini excavator and graded ground, so it is shown as under construction; that photograph is Pier & Point's own observation, not a published source. No source read gives a construction start date, an opening date or an expected completion. This is a different place from the Bridgeview paseo at Mission Rock, about 350 m north.

milestones.text: OCII Commission approves the design of Bridgeview Way Lot B between Blocks 9 and 9A: closed to local vehicular traffic, with removable bollards for emergency vehicle access; approval subject to the Executive Director's review of consistency with the SFMTA Vision Zero plan and of mitigation for the Mission Rock parking structure

open_questions: No source read gives a construction start date, an opening date or an expected completion date for this walkway. The status rests on Pier & Point's own photograph of October 27, 2026.

The April 2024 resolution says that, apart from Bridgeview Way between Blocks 9 and 9A 'depicted as Lot B', 'All development including infrastructure and open space within the Major Phase is complete or imminently under construction'. It does not say when work on Lot B was to start, and no source read says what is being built there now.

The name rests on OCII's description of Bridgeview Way Lot B as 'a private mid-block Vara corridor, between Blocks 9 and 9A' (Resolution No. 08-2024) and the developer's plan sheets headed '9/9A Midblock (Bridgeview Way)'; no source read calls it a paseo. No source read says Assessor lot 8719004 is Lot B.
